settings.introHTML: This lesson helps you talk about who you are in French. You will practise introducing yourself, describing your personal situation and profession, and answering common personal questions politely. Through listening and speaking tasks, you will also improve key pronunciation patterns for clearer, more natural French.
settings.informationHTML:
You will learn:

  • How to introduce yourself and describe your situation (for example célibataire, marié(e), professions).
  • How to use the verb être with common subject pronouns.
  • How grammatical gender affects articles and agreement in everyday expressions.
  • How to recognise and produce key pronunciation features, including silent final consonants and th.
  • How to respond accurately in guided listening and interactive practice activities.

monologues.instructionsTextHTML: This section introduces a series of short monologues to show how to introduce oneself and describe personal situations and professions in French.

monologues1.informationTextHTML: Read each phrase, then play its audio clip to check pronunciation and meaning.
phrases:
Salut, je suis Sylvain.
Je suis célibataire.
Je suis étudiant en géographie.

Hi, I'm Sylvain.
I'm single.
I'm a geography student.

Bonjour ! Je m'appelle Jacqueline.
Je suis divorcée.
Je suis prof de maths.

Hello, my name's Jacqueline.
I'm divorced.
I'm a maths teacher

Bonsoir ! Je m'appelle Olivier Durand.
Je suis marié avec Alex depuis trois ans.
Je suis bibliothécaire.

Good evening, my name's Olivier Durand.
I've been married to Alex for three years.
I'm a librarian.

vocabulary.instructionsTextHTML: This section introduces the vocabulary used in the unit and presents it in two ways: alphabetically and semantically.
vocabulary.informationTextHTML:
You will learn:

  • Core personal-status vocabulary (marié(e), divorcé(e), séparé(e), fiancé(e), pacsé(e), célibataire).
  • Study and profession terms (for example étudiant(e), professeur(e), médecin, bibliothécaire).
  • Useful ways to ask someone's profession (for example Que faites-vous ?, Quel est votre métier ?).
phrases: What do you do (for a living)?
What do you do (for a living)?
Quelle est ta profession ? Quelle est votre profession ?

grammar1.infoTextHTML:
In this section, you will practise the present tense of être so you can introduce yourself and others accurately.

You will learn:

  • How each subject pronoun changes the verb form.
  • How to match French forms with English meanings.
  • How this core verb supports later grammar and exercises.

grammar2.infoTextHTML:
This section helps you recognise noun gender and choose the correct article in context.

You will learn:

  • How to distinguish masculine and feminine nouns.
  • How to use un/une and le/la/l' correctly.
  • How article choice changes before vowels and silent h.

subject-pronouns.infoTextHTML:
In this section, you will clarify how French subject pronouns map to people and grammatical gender.

You will learn:

  • How singular and plural pronouns are used in real sentences.
  • When to use il/elle and ils/elles.
  • How iel functions as a gender-neutral singular pronoun.

instructionsLayout.paragraphHTML: This section introduces key grammar and usage points to help you describe yourself and others in French, with a focus on être, grammatical gender, and subject pronouns.

pronunciation1.informationTextHTML: Focus on identifying silent final letters in context. Listen closely, repeat each example aloud, and notice which endings are not pronounced.
pronunciation1.titleText: 1. Silent letters at the end of a word

pronunciation2.informationTextHTML: In this part, practise words with th. Train your ear to hear the French t sound and repeat each model clearly.

dropdowns3.instructionsText: Select the correct part of être to fill in the gaps.
dropdowns3.informationTextHTML: Read each sentence and choose the correct form of être for the subject. Work through all items first, then use Check answers to review your choices. If needed, use Show answer to reveal correct forms, and Reset to try again.

dropdowns4.instructionsText: Match each question with the correct answer.
dropdowns4.informationTextHTML: Play each audio clip and choose the text option that matches what you hear. When you finish, use Check answers to review, Reset to try again, or Show answers to reveal the solutions.
